scope: Owner-confirmed business operations, research-based FAQ and clearly labelled illustrative cost example; 3dyanimda only.

ownerConfirmed.onsiteScanning: All Turkish provinces; appointment after quotation approval; travel/accommodation separate quote items.
ownerConfirmed.shipping: Inbound samples and return shipment; price depends on project.
ownerConfirmed.dropoff: Customer can drop off and collect; time agreed with customer.
ownerConfirmed.rapidPrototyping: 48 hours; project scope and start confirmed, transport separate.
ownerConfirmed.materials: More than 50 filament varieties; ASA, PETG, ABS, ABS FR, HT PETG, PLA, Silk PLA, Hyper PETG among used options.
ownerConfirmed.engineering: Corporate engineering team, up to 10 years individual experience, no personal biographies.
ownerConfirmed.photos: Owner identifies real workshop/device/product photos on official Maps profile; linked, not copied or attributed to invented customer cases.

contactOperations.visit_note: Parçanızı Ataşehir’deki atölyemize elden bırakabilir ve işlem sonrasında geri alabilirsiniz. Ziyaret ve teslim saatini sizinle görüşerek planlıyoruz.
contactOperations.delivery_note: Tarama yapılacak parçaları kargoyla kabul ediyor ve işlem sonrasında geri gönderiyoruz. Gidiş ve dönüş kargo ücretleri projeye göre belirlenir. İstanbul’un tüm ilçelerine kurye hizmetimiz vardır; kurye ücreti projeye göre belirlenir. İstanbul dışına ürün gönderimi kargoyla yapılır.
contactOperations.onsite_note: Türkiye’nin tüm illerinde müşterinin adresinde 3D tarama yapıyoruz. Şehir dışı işlerde ulaşım ve gerektiğinde konaklama giderleri teklifte ayrı kalem olarak belirtilir. Yerinde tarama randevusu teklif onayından sonra kesinleşir.

research.method: Primary manufacturer documentation, original Turkish FAQ wording. These are not measured customer-frequency data.

truthfulLimits.publication: 13 old guide first-publication dates remain unknown; no random dates. Visible update date reflects this change. Owner remembers 10 February start, year/article dates not substantiated.
truthfulLimits.price: Hypothetical cost scenario, 750 TRY subtotal excluding VAT/shipping, expressly not a real customer quote or current tariff. No Offer schema.
truthfulLimits.software: Published software brands without unverified version numbers.
truthfulLimits.materials: No invented TDS, flame class or temperature guarantee.
truthfulLimits.references: No customer names/logos added, per owner.
